meta.name: social-text-websense-gate
meta.description: Use when drafting, reviewing, or revising Xiaohongshu/Douyin/social-platform Chinese text so it has real internet-native judgment instead of README tone, technical-briefing tone, or mechanical meme-word stuffing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文案改出小红书/抖音的网感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写社交文案总像说明书或堆砌网络热词。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite text with real social-platform vibe for Xiaohongshu or Douyin.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your social copy sounds like a manual or just stuffs memes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把小红书、抖音等平台的中文文案改得像真人发帖，避免像说明书或发布会稿。它会找出文案里的荒谬点，用自然的口语表达，而不是硬塞网络词。
howto.when: 当你写或改小红书/抖音文案，或觉得文案太正经、像AI写的、没网感时触发。

say.text: 帮我改一下这段小红书文案，让它有网感。
say.note: Claude 会按网感规则重写文案。

say.text: 这段抖音口播太像技术发布会了，帮我改得接地气。
say.note: Claude 会去掉宏观趋势开头，换成具体场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps rewrite Chinese social-media copy (Xiaohongshu, Douyin) to sound like a real internet user, avoiding README or launch-event tone. It identifies absurd points and uses natural speech instead of meme-word stuffing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when drafting or revising Xiaohongshu/Douyin copy, or when the user says the copy is too formal, AI-like, or lacks internet-native feel.

say_en.text: Rewrite this Xiaohongshu caption to have internet-native feel.
say_en.note: Claude rewrites the copy per websense rules.

say_en.text: This Douyin script sounds like a tech keynote, make it more down-to-earth.
say_en.note: Claude removes macro trends and starts with a concrete situation.
